title: 第596章 寻矿第595章 玄螟
content_zh:
脱离那扰人心神的玄冰螟虫群覆盖范围，一口气飞出数十里后，许星遥神念扫过，寻了一处巨大的冰岩裂缝。裂缝狭窄深邃，他闪身进入，立刻在入口处布下数道简易的隐匿与预警禁制，随即盘膝坐下，开始打坐调息。
动用本命寒焰击杀虫王，看似轻描淡写，一击必杀，实则对他负荷极大。那寒焰乃是他道基所系的一缕本源，催动之时，不仅消耗海量灵力，更牵扯心神精元。
他不敢有丝毫大意，身处这危机四伏的玄冰寒渊，状态不佳便是取死之道。他迅速从储物袋中取出两枚龙散发着浓郁药香的“回元丹”，毫不犹豫地服下。丹药入口即化，化作两股温和醇厚的暖流，迅速顺着喉管而下，散入四肢百骸。《太始寒天章》全力运转，引导着药力，同时贪婪地吸纳着此地精纯无比的冰属灵气。
足足调息了三个时辰，许星遥青白的脸上才恢复了些许血色消耗的灵力在丹药和功法的双重作用下，恢复了七八成，虽然距离巅峰状态尚有距离，但已无大碍。神魂的刺痛也基本平复，只是精神上仍残留着一丝疲惫。他缓缓睁开眼，目光已恢复了往日的沉静。
冰岩裂缝外，风雪依旧，只是比起之前似乎小了一些。许星遥挥手撤去入口的禁制，走出裂缝，冰冷的寒风夹杂着细碎的雪沫扑面而来，带着熟悉的寒意，却也让他精神为之一振，驱散了最后一点调息后的沉滞感。
他没有立刻动身，继续朝着秘境深处未知的方向前行，而是站在原地，目光越过茫茫雪原，投向之前玄冰螟虫群出现的那个方向，陷入了沉思。方才急于脱身和恢复，许多细节未来得及细想，此刻安全下来，一些疑点浮上心头。
“玄冰螟……通常只诞生并栖息于极寒之地的矿脉深处……”许星遥低声自语，脑海中快速回忆着关于此虫的记载。
“此地环境酷寒，蕴含玄冰煞气，能孕育出玄冰螟倒也不算奇怪。但一路行来，这片冰原贫瘠无比，未见任何矿脉迹象……可如此规模的玄冰螟虫群，绝不可能凭空出现，更不可能远离其巢穴长期活动。”
“也就是说，”
许星遥眼中闪过一丝锐利的精光，仿佛穿透了眼前的风雪，“这群玄冰螟的巢穴，或者说它们赖以生存的矿脉，很可能就在这附近！”
念及此处，许星遥心中有了决断。能被玄冰螟这种奇异妖虫选为巢穴，并供养出如此庞大族群的矿脉，其中蕴含的矿物，绝非寻常寒铁、玄冰之流，很可能是某种罕见甚至极品的高阶冰属性灵材！他转过身，开始沿着之前虫群来袭的大致方向探寻过去。
只是寻找矿脉，并非易事，尤其是在这环境恶劣的广袤冰原上。玄冰螟虽然可能源自附近矿脉，但它们飞行迅疾，巢穴具体位置难以精准确定。
许星遥将神念尽可能外放，仔细感知着脚下冰雪深处传来的任何异常波动。同时，他放慢遁速，仔细观察着周围的地形地貌、冰层色泽、甚至风雪中蕴含的灵气细微变化。
一个时辰过去了，除了永无止境的风雪和千篇一律的冰雪景象，一无所获。两个时辰过去了，目之所及依旧是白茫茫一片，没有任何有价值的发现。许星遥并不气馁，寻找矿脉本就需要耐心和运气，尤其是这种可能被冰雪深深掩埋的隐脉。
他走走停停，不时停下身形，用手拂开表层浮雪，仔细观察下方的冰层，甚至偶尔祭起冰剑，向下挖掘，探查冰层下的土壤岩石。可惜，除了万年不化的坚冰和冻土，什么都没，什么都没有发现，连一丝矿石碎屑都未见。
就在许星遥怀疑自己是否判断错误，或者那矿脉距离此地极远，虫群只是偶然远距离巡游至此，自己只是在做无用功时，他忽然在一处不甚起眼的冰丘脚下，停下了脚步。
这里的冰层颜色，似乎与周围呈现出浑浊白色的冰原有些许不同。在昏暗的天光映照下，这一小片冰丘区域，隐隐泛着一层不仔细观察根本无法察觉的灰蓝色光泽。而且，当他站在这片区域时，能感觉到从脚下传来的寒气，似乎比周围更沉重一些，那无孔不入的煞意之中，也隐约夹杂上了一丝微弱的阴寒金气。
“有古怪。”
许星遥心中一动，蹲下身，并指如剑，一缕灵力透指而出，小心翼翼地刮向那冰面。
“嗤……”

冰屑纷飞。只见刮开的冰面下，并非纯净的冰晶，而是夹杂着无数细小的黑色颗粒！这些颗粒极为细腻，均匀地分布在冰层之中。
许星遥用手指拈起一点冰屑，放在鼻尖下方，轻轻一嗅。一股绝不属于冰雪，类似铁锈般的微弱气味传入鼻腔。他又尝试着将一丝灵力注入这些冰屑，，仔细感应。与之接触的瞬间，他感到自己的灵力似乎被微微“刺痛”了一下。
“这是……‘玄阴砂’？不对，玄阴砂色泽更暗，寒气更重……这颗粒颜色稍浅，寒意虽阴却似乎不够纯，倒更像是某种矿石的碎屑，或者……是被玄冰螟啃噬后残留的矿渣？”
许星遥回忆着脑海中的矿藏知识，不太确定地猜测。
但无论如何，这发现是一个明确的信号！这冰层中混杂的颗粒，绝非天然形成，只能是来自地下深处的矿脉！
“看来矿脉就在这个方向，而且距离不会太远！”
content_en:
After escaping from the coverage area of ​​the disturbing black ice borer swarm and flying dozens of miles in one breath, Xu Xingyao scanned with his mind and found a huge ice rock crack. The crack was narrow and deep. He ducked in and immediately placed several simple concealment and warning restrictions at the entrance. Then he sat down cross-legged and began to meditate and adjust his breath.
Using the cold flames of his life to kill the Insect King may seem like an understatement, killing him with one strike, but in fact it puts a huge load on him. That cold flame is a ray of origin attached to his Dao Foundation. When activated, it not only consumes a massive amount of spiritual energy, but also involves the mental energy.
He didn't dare to be careless at all. In this dangerous abyss of black ice, poor condition was the way to die. He quickly took out two "Returning Pills" that exuded a strong medicinal fragrance from his storage bag and drank them without hesitation. The elixir melts immediately in the mouth, turning into two gentle and mellow warm currents, quickly flowing down the throat and spreading into the limbs and bones. "Taishi Hantian Chapter" is operating at full strength, guiding the power of the medicine, and at the same time greedily absorbing the extremely pure ice spiritual energy of this place.
After adjusting his breath for three hours, some color returned to Xu Xingyao's pale face. The consumed spiritual power, under the dual effects of the pills and exercises, recovered to 70% to 80%. Although he was still far from his peak state, it was no longer a serious problem. The stinging pain in his soul has basically subsided, but there is still a trace of mental fatigue. He slowly opened his eyes, his eyes returning to their usual calmness.
Outside the ice and rock cracks, the wind and snow were still there, but they seemed smaller than before. Xu Xingyao waved his hand to remove the restriction on the entrance, and walked out of the crack. The icy cold wind mixed with fine snow foam hit his face, carrying a familiar chill, but it also cheered him up and dispelled the last bit of sluggishness after adjusting his breath.
He did not set off immediately and continue to move in an unknown direction deep in the secret realm. Instead, he stood there, looking across the vast snowfield to the direction where the black ice borer swarm appeared before, and fell into deep thought. I was in a hurry to escape and recover, and I didn't have time to think about many details in the future. Now that I'm safe, some doubts come to mind.
"The black ice borer... is usually only born and lives in the depths of mineral veins in extremely cold places..." Xu Xingyao whispered to himself, quickly recalling the records about this insect in his mind.
"The environment here is extremely cold and contains the evil energy of black ice. It is not surprising that black ice borers can breed. However, along the way, this ice sheet has been extremely barren and there are no signs of any mineral veins... But a swarm of black ice borers of this size will never appear out of thin air, let alone stay away from its nest for a long time."
"That is to say,"
A sharp light flashed in Xu Xingyao's eyes, as if penetrating the wind and snow in front of him, "The nest of these black ice borers, or the mineral veins they rely on for survival, is probably nearby!"
Thinking of this, Xu Xingyao made a decision in his heart. The mineral veins that can be chosen as nests by strange demonic insects like the Black Ice Borer and support such a huge group of people, the minerals contained in them are definitely not ordinary cold iron or black ice. They are likely to be some kind of rare or even top-grade high-level ice-attribute spiritual materials! He turned around and began to explore along the general direction of the previous insect swarm attack.
Just looking for mineral veins is not an easy task, especially on this vast ice sheet with harsh environment. Although the black ice borers may have originated from nearby mineral veins, they fly very fast and the exact location of their nests is difficult to determine accurately.
Xu Xingyao spread his spiritual thoughts as far as possible, carefully sensing any abnormal fluctuations coming from the depths of the ice and snow under his feet. At the same time, he slowed down his escape speed and carefully observed the surrounding topography, the color of the ice, and even the subtle changes in the aura contained in the wind and snow.
An hour passed, and nothing was found except the never-ending wind and snow and the same ice and snow scene. Two hours have passed, and everything as far as the eye can see is still a vast expanse of white, without any valuable discoveries. Xu Xingyao is not discouraged. Finding mineral veins requires patience and luck, especially hidden veins that may be deeply buried by ice and snow.
He walked and walked, stopping from time to timeStanding tall, he brushed away the floating snow on the surface with his hands, carefully observed the ice below, and even occasionally used his ice sword to dig down to explore the soil and rocks under the ice. Unfortunately, there was nothing but solid ice and frozen soil that had not melted for thousands of years. Nothing was found, not even a trace of ore fragments.
Just when Xu Xingyao was wondering whether his judgment was wrong, or the mineral vein was extremely far away from here, and the swarm of insects just wandered here accidentally, and he was just doing useless work, he suddenly stopped at the foot of an inconspicuous ice hill.
The color of the ice here seems to be slightly different from the surrounding turbid white ice fields. Under the dim skylight, this small area of ​​​​ice mounds was faintly glowing with a gray-blue luster that could not be detected without careful observation. Moreover, when he stood in this area, he could feel the cold air coming from his feet, which seemed to be heavier than the surroundings. The all-pervasive evil spirit was also vaguely mixed with a faint cold golden air.
"Something weird."
Xu Xingyao's heart moved. He squatted down and pointed like a sword. A ray of spiritual power came out of his finger and scraped it carefully against the ice.
"Tsk..."
Ice shards flew. I saw that under the scraped ice surface, there were not pure ice crystals, but countless tiny black particles! These particles are extremely fine and evenly distributed in the ice layer.
Xu Xingyao picked up some ice chips with his fingers, placed it under the tip of his nose, and sniffed gently. A faint smell that was definitely not ice or snow, but similar to rust, entered the nose. He tried to inject a trace of spiritual power into these ice chips again, sensing them carefully. The moment he came into contact with it, he felt that his spiritual power seemed to be slightly "tingled".
"This is...'Xuanyin Sand'? No, the color of Xuanyin Sand is darker, and the coldness is heavier...The color of these particles is slightly lighter, and although the coldness is cloudy, it seems not pure enough. It is more like the debris of some kind of ore, or...the slag left after being eaten by the Black Ice Borer?"
Xu Xingyao recalled the mineral knowledge in his mind and guessed uncertainly.
But regardless, this discovery is a clear signal! The particles mixed in this ice layer are definitely not naturally formed, they can only come from mineral veins deep underground!
“It seems that the mineral vein is in this direction, and it’s not too far away!”
